candidates.verdict: Use the warmup built into your sender

decision: Never cold-email from the main product domain. Buy one or two lookalike domains, set SPF + DKIM (2048-bit) + DMARC (p=none, then quarantine), warm each inbox, and keep spam rate under 0.3% (aim for 0.1%). Bulk senders (>5,000/day to Gmail) also need one-click unsubscribe. Zoho Mail Forever Free has no IMAP/POP, so sequencers can't connect to it. Sending inboxes need Zoho Mail Lite, Google Workspace, or mailboxes bought through Apollo.

verify.note: DMARC Management is 'Available on all plans' and needs Cloudflare DNS; no extra charge stated. Zoho Forever Free has 'IMAP/POP/Active Sync not included' (confirmed). Postmark alt confirmed (free: top 10 sources, 7 days, weekly email; paid USD 14/mo/domain). Note Apollo's free plan connects Gmail only, so the outbound mailboxes should be Google Workspace if Apollo stays on free.
